# LevelPlate

The level display.

`LL.LevelPlate` · Game Components · Character

## Use

```jsx
<LL.LevelPlate level={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.LevelPlate" level="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (LevelPlateProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `level` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `kicker` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `xp` | `number` |  |
| `xpMax` | `number` |  |
| `xpUnit` | `string` | Unit after the progress numbers. Default "EXP". |
| `aside` | `{ icon?: IconName; label: React.ReactNode; value: number \| string; unit?: string }[]` | Up to two side stats. `unit` follows the value, smaller and muted ("12s", "84 HP/5s"). |
